en: Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy market square filled with horse‑drawn wagons, stalls and people. On the left stands a large, ornate stone building with classical detailing; behind the square are multi‑storey brick buildings and, in the distance, tall factory chimneys emitting smoke. The image is bordered by handwritten text in a cursive script along the right edge and bottom, with a vertically written note on the left margin.
